title: PCA on S-PLUS photometry: Fornax cluster
description: Principal Component Analysis on 66-colour S-PLUS photometry to separate cluster members from background/foreground objects in the Fornax cluster. Combines WCS astrometry and multi-band photometric catalogues.

title: Antlia cluster — deep photometry
description: Deep photometric survey of the Antlia galaxy cluster. WCS calibration, source detection and morphological classification of dwarf galaxy candidates.

title: LightGBM trading signal pipeline
description: End-to-end ML pipeline for intraday signal generation. Feature engineering on OHLCV data, LightGBM classifier, Optuna hyperparameter search, and real-time inference via AWS Lambda. Includes walk-forward validation to prevent leakage.

title: Out-of-core data processing with Dask
description: Processing multi-GB tabular datasets that exceed RAM using Dask DataFrames. Benchmarks against Pandas and Polars, with deployment on AWS EMR Serverless for scalable ETL jobs.

title: MLOps pipeline on AWS SageMaker
description: CI/CD pipeline for ML models: automated retraining, model registry, A/B deployment and drift monitoring. Infrastructure as code with Terraform. Observability via CloudWatch dashboards.
